thread:
mike: Heads-up: PR 41299 touches runtime KV eviction and routing logic. Need runtime + security + infra eyes. Target merge Thurs 09:00 PT if we get approvals. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/41299

tara: Link looks good. @sasha @diego can you take a look? runtime changes are small but affect eviction heuristics and routing fallback.

sasha: I can review the runtime changes, will check perf test results. quick q: does this change eviction thresholds for pinned models?

mike: Yes — adds a config flag `eviction.threshold_factor` (default 1.0) and a fallback route when eviction can't free enough space. Small diff snippet in the PR: 

```
- if (usage > capacity) evict_least_recent();
+ if (usage > capacity * config.eviction.threshold_factor) evict_least_recent();
```

Perf regression CI is running but I want infra signoff for the rollout plan (canary sizing / reserve capacity).

diego: Security note: need a short threat/case writeup in the PR about KV fallback behavior. Any chance the fallback could route models to a different tenant or leak keys? I'll ping @sec-oncall after that.

sasha: Noted — also seeing a flaky in perf-suite-3. Re-triggering. @infra-bot can you confirm job status for the PR?

infra-bot: CI pipeline for PR 41299: perf-suite-3 failed (timeout). Rerun queued.

mike: Thanks — I added a short threat note in the PR description: "KV fallback routes only to a smaller model variant in the same VPC, does not create cross-tenant routing. No new secrets in logs." Also added a `--no-cache` flag for sensitive workloads. Linking KMS test: https://internal-ci/kms-tests/789

tara: For merge timing — if security gives conditional LGTM, plan is: canary in us-west-2 at 10% traffic for 2 hours, then stage roll to 50% and monitor for 24h. @sasha can you own canary monitoring and dashboards?

sasha: Yep, I'll set up dashboards, SLO alerts, and a quick smoke-runbook. I'll need infra to reserve 2x small GPU pool for the canary window.

diego: For formal signoff I need: 1) short threat note in PR, 2) audit logs enabled for fallback routing, 3) KMS key usage validated. Once those are present I'll +1 with conditions.

mike: Updated PR with the checklist and links to the KMS validation and audit settings. If no blockers, I'll queue for merge Thurs 09:00 PT and request the merge slot.

tara: Sounds good — ping me when security + infra are green and I'll stamp the merge-slot. :thumbsup:
